items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and continue only the existing period-aligned measurement and attribution reconciliation. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, but retained cost records conflict. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable. Do not authorize spend, billing changes, monetization expansion, forecasts, or unsupported revenue claims.

Minimum measurement for any future financial recommendation: reconcile one identical reporting window for provider revenue, tracking IDs, AI costs, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and approved budgets; preserve aggregate provider rows separately from site-attributed rows; define one learning outcome per experiment with baseline, incremental cost, and result; and calculate site contribution margin as attributable revenue minus directly assigned variable costs. Until this exists, treat traffic, impressions, clicks, conversions, technical scores, and ordered items without attributable commission as operating or vanity metrics—not financial returns.
